verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents an official API to post a chatMessage to a channel, and Teams Export APIs let a program read channel messages. Bots can also take part in conversations, so an agent can read and post through first-party APIs. However, nothing in the pack covers scoped tokens or permission scopes, and one community report notes integration needs the full Azure/Graph stack. Missing for 10: documentation of scoped token/permission models for channel read/post, a documented standard (non-export) channel message read endpoint, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent read and post channel messages through the official API using scoped tokens
